g.text: Dashed line: median shift of the 11,003 genes in neither group, the whole-transcriptome move each inhibitor produces. Numbers are each group's median after removing it.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: In Th17n, PGAM inhibition moves both gene groups, not the pro-inflammatory group alone
GSE290297 division-1 libraries | genes partitioned by the deposit's own DMSO Th17p-versus-Th17n contrast
(BH ≤ 0.05 and |log₂ FC| ≥ 1.5), then plotted against each inhibitor
Library-level descriptive contrasts on deposited TPM; no animal field exists, so none of this is animal-level inference. Group medians are post-hoc readouts of the governed table.
Centring removes the global shift but does not make the groups independent.
